_doc: Nebula AI bundled model manifest — single authority for the pinned HuggingFace model URL, SHA-256, filename, and metadata. Consumed at build time by stage_nebula_model() in scripts/build-iso.sh and at boot time indirectly via the MANIFEST.sha256 generated from this source. DEC-PHASE11-002 (model swap: Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct Q4_K_M, Apache-2.0), DEC-PHASE10-008 (HF staging + ORIONX_MODEL_LOCAL air-gap fallback). Mirror: bartowski primary / Qwen upstream fallback per DEC-PHASE11-002.
_integrity_note: model_sha256 is pinned to the verified SHA-256 extracted from CI build log run 29305215942 (DEC-PHASE10-008 trust-on-first-use pattern; W11-2e follow-up commit, closes #67). Value is deterministic per DEC-PHASE10-008. model_filename governs the on-disk name written by wget -O in stage_nebula_model(); source URL filenames may differ in case — the manifest filename field is authoritative.
_size_note: model_size_bytes is the expected on-disk size of the Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct Q4_K_M GGUF (approximately 1.9 GB). ISO size target ≤3.0 GB compressed (Phase 11 lean-release goal ~2.8 GB per DEC-PHASE11-001). A WARN (not fail) is emitted by build-iso.sh if the final ISO exceeds 7 GB (DEC-PHASE10-012); effective warn threshold for content-presence size check relaxed to 3 GB for this smaller model per DEC-PHASE10-012.
_mirror_note: Primary: bartowski/Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct-GGUF — post-TheBloke community standard for GGUF mirrors, non-gated for Apache-2.0 models. Fallback: Qwen/Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct-GGUF — official upstream Qwen team mirror, non-gated. hf_commit_sha deferred — pin in same follow-up commit that pins model_sha256 per #56 / #57 pattern.
